text: They had lost the argument. So they turned to force.
"Burn him, and support your gods, if you are to act."
They gathered wood for days. They built a fire so great that no one could come near it, and they hurled him into it from far away.
A young man, alone, falling into the flames.
And then Allah gave the fire a single command: "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim."
The fire that was made to burn... obeyed its Creator. It burned his ropes, and not him.
"And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers."
